issue_title: AI-Native SMB Platform Landscape: Gap Analysis & Agentic Solutions
issue_description: Current platforms either offer robust features wrapped in complex technical interfaces (Shopify) or basic simplicity lacking true end-to-end operational power (Link-in-bio tools). AI-native tools (Durable, 10web) focus primarily on *website generation*, missing the ongoing operational needs of a business. OHC's unique value lies in **AI as invisible operational infrastructure** rather than a mere generation tool.
